polygon_not_connected.title: Polygon is not connected
polygon_not_connected.fix: An administrator needs to save the Polygon API key and secret in Settings.

polygon_unauthorized.title: Polygon refused the API key
polygon_unauthorized.fix: The Polygon key or secret is wrong. An administrator needs to save it again in Settings.

polygon_clock_skew.title: Polygon refused the signature
polygon_clock_skew.fix: The server clock is off from Polygon's. Tell an administrator.

polygon_failed.title: Polygon answered with an error
polygon_failed.fix: Try again in a few minutes.

polygon_unavailable.title: Polygon cannot be reached
polygon_unavailable.fix: Polygon did not answer. Try again in a few minutes.

polygon_package_unavailable.title: Polygon could not hand over the package
polygon_package_unavailable.fix: Try again in a few minutes; if it keeps failing, build a new package on Polygon.

polygon_package_too_large.title: The package is larger than 512 MiB
polygon_package_too_large.fix: Make the tests smaller, then build a new package on Polygon.

import_failed.title: The import failed
import_failed.fix: Something went wrong on the server. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell an administrator.

package_invalid.title: Part of the package cannot be converted
package_invalid.fix: Fix the part named below on Polygon, build a new package, then import again.

package_incomplete.title: The full package has no tests
package_incomplete.fix: The package was built without its tests. Build a full package with tests on Polygon.

package_needs_full.title: This problem needs a full package
package_needs_full.fix: An interactive problem or a multi-file generator needs a full package. Build one on Polygon.

too_many_testcases.title: {count} tests, over the limit of {limit}
too_many_testcases.fix: Leave out the 0-point groups or tests, or remove tests on Polygon.

statement_language_required.title: No main statement picked
statement_language_required.fix: The package has the statements {languages}. Pick one as the main statement.

statement_language_unmapped.title: The {language} statement has no language
statement_language_unmapped.fix: Pick en, vi or Skip for the {language} statement.

statement_language_repeated.title: Two statements are both {language}
statement_language_repeated.fix: Give one of them another language, or Skip it.

tutorial_language_required.title: No tutorial picked
tutorial_language_required.fix: The package has tutorials in {languages}. Pick one as the editorial.

checker_unsupported.title: The package's checker cannot run here
checker_unsupported.fix: Change the checker on Polygon, build a new package, then import again.

generation_failed.title: Generating the tests on a judge failed
generation_failed.fix: Check the generators and the main solution on Polygon, or use a full package.

generation_no_judge.title: No judge to generate the tests
generation_no_judge.fix: It was retried once already. Try again when a judge is online.

generation_timeout.title: Generating the tests took too long
generation_timeout.fix: Use a full package to skip test generation.

storage_full.title: Not enough storage
storage_full.fix: The organization has no room for this package. Ask an administrator to raise its quota.

problem_code_taken.title: The problem code is taken
problem_code_taken.fix: Pick another code, or choose Update to overwrite that problem.

problem_not_found.title: The problem to update is gone
problem_not_found.fix: It was deleted or its code changed. Check the code.

problem_not_importable.title: This problem cannot take an import
problem_not_importable.fix: It is deleted, a mirror, managed by hand, or its markup changed. Pick another problem.

problem_changed.title: The problem changed while the job waited
problem_changed.fix: Its tests or content were just edited. Try again to import over the new state.

problem_unlinked.title: The problem was unlinked
problem_unlinked.fix: It was no longer linked to Polygon when the sync ran.

polygon_already_linked.title: This Polygon problem is already linked
polygon_already_linked.fix: It is linked to another QHHOJ problem. Update that one instead of creating a new one.

requester_forbidden.title: Missing a permission
requester_forbidden.fix: You lost a permission the job needs. Ask an administrator for it.

imported_needs_attention.title: Imported, but placing the data files failed
imported_needs_attention.fix: Sync again to place the data files; the settings stay as they are.

unknown.title: The import failed
unknown.fix: The server gave no reason. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell an administrator.
